comment: Source read at commit 21bfcbf, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.0. The Rate input replaces the knob rather than being added to it, and its law (24.995 V + 250.05, PolyAutoPan.cpp:44) is not clamped, so a voltage outside ±10V runs the sweep faster than 500 beats per minute or backwards. Output index 0 is the right side and index 1 the left, which is the reverse of the usual order.
